text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Even though I swore my loyalty to my 
master... To have betrayed their 
expectations time and time again...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
At this rate, I can't call myself a proud 
knight...!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
! H-How could I...! Forgive me, showing 
such weakness in front of my Master...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She laments having suffered defeat time 
and time again... but for a knight, true 
defeat isn't merely losing a match.
choice_data_list: As a knight, you haven't lost yet.

As a knight, you shouldn't be defeated 
yet.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"A true defeat for a knight... is to 
surrender their sword of their own will."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
My loyalty has never wavered. I will take 
to the battlefield as many times as it 
takes—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: That is the very chivalry I must uphold!
choice_data_list: That nobility is what makes you Durandal.
That nobility is what makes you Durandal.

This is your chance to prove your worth as 
a knight!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: That is the very chivalry I must uphold!
choice_data_list: That nobility is what makes you Durandal.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"I am deeply grateful for your words of 
encouragement. ...I shall walk this path 
once more."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I am the knight, Durandal. Next time, 
without fail, I shall bring victory to my 
liege!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I swear to overcome any training and 
hone my blade to perfection.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
And next time, I will surely bring you 
victory!
